hypotheses.D0_model_exposes_dialect_state: The native US-minus-UK output contrast classifies matched held-out prefix labels with AUROC at least 0.65.
hypotheses.D1_boundary_leading_mode_encodes_dialect: The discovery-oriented L9H8 leading write-mode score classifies held-out dialect labels with AUROC at least 0.65 and exceeds both controls by 0.05.
hypotheses.D2_boundary_full_write_encodes_dialect: A discovery-fitted L9H8 write direction classifies held-out dialect labels with AUROC at least 0.75 and exceeds both controls by 0.05.
hypotheses.D3_boundary_edge_transmits_dialect_to_lo: The L9H8 finite edge contribution to the US-minus-UK logit contrast has held-out signed AUROC at least 0.60 and exceeds both controls by 0.05.
hypotheses.D4_address_controls_are_balanced: Boundary-token type and log-distance alone classify held-out labels with AUROC at most 0.55.
hypotheses.D5_dialect_interpretation_is_supported: D0, D2, D3, and D4 all hold.
